title: Daily Digest A: Injury Watch (Fri Nov 20)
parts:
🩹 DEVYDOSE INJURY WATCH | Fri, Nov 20

Thursday's availability reports: the No. 1 QB on the board is still out, South Carolina's QB is off the list for Georgia, and two Gamecock receivers moved in opposite directions 🧵👇

🩹 JULIAN SAYIN | Ohio State | JR, 5⭐ | #1 QB

Listed out on Ohio State's availability report for the Nebraska game (via ABC6 Columbus).

He opened the year #2 QB in the Alpha Draft Signal.

🐔 SOUTH CAROLINA vs Georgia (via DawgNation)

✅ LaNorris Sellers | South Carolina | SR, 4⭐ | #30 QB: not on Thursday's SEC report. He missed the Arkansas game with an ankle injury.

✅ Nyck Harbor | South Carolina | SR, 5⭐ | #27 WR: upgraded to probable.

🩹 Mazeo Bennett | South Carolina | JR, 4⭐ | #98 WR: downgraded to doubtful Thursday.

🩹 Landon Roldan | Georgia | SO, 4⭐ | #320 WR: ruled out Thursday after not being listed Wednesday.

Both via DawgNation.

Whose status are you watching Saturday? 👇
